highlights: The AI landscape sees a surge in advanced agentic capabilities, with open-source models gaining sophisticated reasoning for enterprise use and multi-agent systems achieving autonomous mathematical discovery.

Significant strides in AI infrastructure and developer tools are being made, including open-source edge model benchmarking, custom inference chips for efficiency, and novel networking protocols for large-scale training.

Industry focus intensifies on practical deployment challenges, highlighted by frameworks for robust agent monitoring, secure local model execution, and critical data privacy provisions for enterprise adoption.

agents.title: Autonomous Mathematical Discovery in an Open-World Multi-Agent Environment
agents.summary: This research introduces 'The Station,' a multi-agent environment where AI agents autonomously conduct research, experiments, and collaborate, leading to novel mathematical discoveries and theorems without central coordination.

agents.title: LLM Agents Perform Controlled Experiments Using Simulation Models
agents.summary: A new multi-agent framework enables LLM agents to design and execute controlled experiments with scientific simulation models, interpreting outcomes and synthesizing evidence-based recommendations for complex tasks like pharmaceutical process design.

agents.title: Gemini API Managed Agents: 3.6 Flash, hooks, and more
agents.summary: Google is expanding its Gemini API Managed Agents with new capabilities like 3.6 Flash and hooks, empowering developers to build reliable, production-ready, and more flexible AI agents.

models.title: Generalist AI Releases GEN-1.5: A Robot Foundation Model That Learns New Tasks From One 3–12 Second Demo
models.summary: Generalist AI introduces GEN-1.5, a robot foundation model capable of learning new physical tasks from a single 3-12 second sensorimotor demonstration, enabling one-shot in-context robotic task execution without fine-tuning.

models.title: IBM Releases Granite 4.2: Bringing Native Reasoning and Agentic RL to Open Enterprise Models
models.summary: IBM has released Granite 4.2, a family of open-source reasoning language models (3B, 8B, 30B) under Apache 2.0, featuring native tool calling and agentic reinforcement learning for code editing, terminal interaction, and web searches in sandboxed environments.

models.title: MolEmb: Multimodal Large Language Models Can Be Strong Molecular Embedding Models
models.summary: MolEmb is a new framework that adapts multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to serve as general molecular embedding models, producing context-aware molecular representations competitive for property prediction and cross-modal retrieval, significant for computational chemistry.

tools.title: Liquid AI Open-Sources Pipette: A Reproducible Benchmarking Suite That Measures On-Device Models, Quantization, Runtime and Hardware Together
tools.summary: Liquid AI has open-sourced Pipette, a benchmarking platform designed to measure foundation models accurately on edge devices, considering quantization, runtime, and hardware performance, addressing a critical gap in on-device model evaluation.

tools.title: Jalapeño’s first results show industry-leading speed and efficiency in AI inference
tools.summary: OpenAI's custom inference chip, Jalapeño, demonstrates industry-leading speed and efficiency for AI inference, promising higher throughput and lower latency for modern models, which is crucial for scalable and cost-effective AI deployment.

tools.title: Meta AI Introduces MetaRoCE: A Clean-Sheet RDMA Transport Built for AI-Scale Ethernet
tools.summary: Meta AI has introduced MetaRoCE, a new RDMA transport solution built from the ground up for AI-scale Ethernet, addressing critical networking bottlenecks that can strand significant compute capacity during the training of frontier models.

companies.title: Best GPU Neoclouds 2026: CoreWeave, Nebius, Lambda, Crusoe, and Groq Ranked by Published Pricing and Contracted Power
companies.summary: This report provides a comprehensive ranking and comparison of the five largest GPU neocloud providers—CoreWeave, Nebius, Lambda, Crusoe, and Groq—detailing their pricing, Q2 2026 financials, and contracted power, essential for builders planning AI infrastructure.

companies.title: Offering Zero Data Retention for frontier models
companies.summary: OpenAI reaffirms its Zero Data Retention policy for eligible API customers and previews Private Safety Processing, enhancing data privacy and security for enterprise users leveraging their frontier AI models.

companies.title: Replit expands access to software creation with GPT-5.6 Luna
companies.summary: Replit introduces 'Free Mode,' powered by OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Luna, significantly expanding access to AI-assisted software creation by allowing users to turn ideas into working code without concerns about token costs.

learning.title: Inside our 353,000-person vibe coding course
learning.summary: Kaggle and Google collaborated on the 'AI Agents Intensive,' a massive, no-cost coding course that brought over 353,000 learners together to build and deploy the next generation of AI agents, providing hands-on skill development.

learning.title: Training and Finetuning Multi-Vector Embedding Models with Sentence Transformers
learning.summary: This guide provides practical insights and methods for training and fine-tuning multi-vector embedding models using Sentence Transformers, a crucial technique for developers working on advanced information retrieval and semantic search systems.

learning.title: Wire It, Run It, Deploy It: AI Workflows in Gradio
learning.summary: This guide details how to build, run, and deploy AI workflows effectively using Gradio, offering practical steps for developers to create and share interactive AI applications with ease.
